title: creative crosshair
description: This resource pack modifies the crosshair.
body: The crosshair has been changed in this set of resources. In this set of resources, the usual crosshair has been replaced with the crosshair I created. The history of creating this set of resources: I got bored with vanilla crosshair, and I decided to create my own crosshair, which I liked, I use this set of resources myself.
